text:
claire: Heads-up: onboarding sample app routed calls to the org key after a project key rotation. Short repro below.

claire: repro steps: export RW_API_KEY_PROJECT=proj-9a8b, export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org-1aa2, start the demo, rotate the project key via console, then new calls appear billed to org key.

josh: I can repro. The auth loader picks REDWOOD_API_KEY during a hot-reload. Log excerpt: `auth.loader: envs=[REDWOOD_API_KEY,RW_API_KEY_PROJECT] chosen=REDWOOD_API_KEY`. That's counterintuitive since project keys should take precedence.

rachel: Minimal repro snippet:```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="org-1aa2"
export RW_API_KEY_PROJECT="proj-9a8b"
node examples/onboard.js
# header Authorization: Bearer org-1aa2 after rotation
```

claire: Another pain point: streaming clients (SSE/WS) currently close on a 401 after rotation. We should attempt a token refresh and retry once before dropping the connection.

josh: Proposed changes: 1) Enforce explicit precedence: RW_API_KEY_PROJECT > RW_API_KEY_SERVICE > RW_API_KEY_ORG > REDWOOD_API_KEY. 2) Emit a one-time WARN at startup if REDWOOD_API_KEY and any RW_API_KEY_* are both set. 3) Add a startup diag log that prints which env var was selected (masked). 4) For streaming: on 401 call tokenProvider.refresh() (if provided) and retry the failed frame once; if still 401 emit an `auth.rotation_failed` event to the app.

rachel: I like the diag log for observability. Example: `auth.selected=RW_API_KEY_PROJECT (****9a8b)`. Also add a small telemetry ping (anonymized) sdk.auth.conflict_detected when ambiguous envs are found; opt-out via RW_AUTH_TELEMETRY=false.

sdk-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1991 "sdk: env precedence + stream rotation handling"

josh: Implementation notes: revert the loader change that prioritized REDWOOD_API_KEY, add an SDK option `auth.precedence` to override order, and a compatibility flag RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT=true for a migration window. Default RW_ENABLE_TOKEN_REFRESH=true.

rachel: Tests: unit matrix for env permutations, integration test that rotates a key during an active SSE client and asserts either resumed stream or `auth.rotation_failed` event. CI should block regressions.

ci-bot: added pipeline job sdk-auth-env-precedence that runs the new matrix tests.

claire: Docs: onboarding quickstart should recommend unsetting REDWOOD_API_KEY when using project/service keys and include the diag example. Also add a short migration guide for teams hitting the compatibility flag.

josh: I'll open a small PR to change the loader and add the diag + warn. rachel, can you add the telemetry ping and the e2e?

rachel: Yup, I'll add the e2e and a sampleapp patch demonstrating a TokenRefreshHandler that gracefully reconnects a stream.

claire: Action items summarized: josh PR for loader + diag + RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT; rachel e2e + sampleapp patch; docs + onboarding update to recommend clearing REDWOOD_API_KEY; ship the WARN asap.

josh: Thanks — I'll keep the change minimal and behind the compat flag so we don't surprise existing dogfooders.

claire: Closing for now; reopen if further regressions surface. :white_check_mark:
